name: octocode
description: Research local and GitHub code, trace behavior, and apply Octocode workflows for architecture, reviews, documentation, and evaluation.

interface.longDescription: Search local projects and GitHub repositories, trace code behavior, and use the public Octocode skills. Runs the MCP server on your computer. Authenticated GitHub access uses your locally configured credentials; GitHub CLI login is recommended. Node.js and npm are required. Some skills need additional tools or services, configured separately.
defaultPrompt: Set up Octocode for this project.
Trace how authentication works in this repository.
Review this project's architecture using source evidence.
